crossRefs.note: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
For Yahweh of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She…
He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke, and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for…
Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,”…
Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples, like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for…
You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about
translations.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: This is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations, and countries are round about her.
